Subject - Something I've Come Across In The Yard
 Hey Neighbor!
I'm sending an email regarding what caught and kept on holding my notice in your nearby lawn for the longest period of the last month.

I was stoked as it was an old, abandoned, but now a beautiful rose. And the flower had a very rich color. It is not only the beauty which kept me captived by its presence for long.

Its fragrance has also added some flavor to it.
And now the beauty has been enhanced as I could find that there are some new rose plants that came in. 

So just a quick word for the both of these, to make the area much livabler. If possible do keep up its care as well, if its something to do so.

I am sure this small message of the same could brightens your and everyone who visits
